title: Bibimbap
description: A Korean rice bowl with sautéed vegetables, a fried egg and gochujang sauce.
steps: Sauté the beansprouts, mushrooms and courgette separately until just tender, then wilt the spinach.
Fry the rice briefly, stirring in a little gochujang.
Fry the eggs, then divide the rice into bowls, arrange the vegetables around the egg and drizzle with more gochujang.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food bibimbap

notes: Keep each vegetable separate while cooking — the visual contrast is part of what makes bibimbap work.
